notes.title: Kamski Playtest | PATCH 0.0.1 - 23/11/2024
Welcome to the playtest!
notes.content:
Welcome everybody, thank you for taking your time to participate in the playtest of the game. Expect buggy mess, incomplete features and placeholder graphics.

A little background about the game
[hr][/hr]
The game itself uses its own engine to render graphical content on the screen, providing operating system function and in general allowing the game to run. This is a big deal since this takes a lot of time to master and get things right. Unlike game engines like Unreal Engine or Unity, you can't just drag and drop stuff on the screen and magically it works, at least not for now(looking at you Philipː2016gameingameː). So takes a lot of coding even for a simple box on the screen.

Game is very very very early in development

No seriously, we are very early, but we wanted to get the game on steam to have a much easier way of testing it, especially with other people as well. 

Before, we used to have the game on Itch.io where people would have to download the game, just like they would do with any other normal application, open the folder where they installed it and then run the executable from there. 

Uploading the game was also a little bit of work because we were using GitHub's CI to build the release version of the game since Itch.io had a nice little feature where you could integrate the CI to automatically upload it to their site. But despite this it was extra work maintaining the CI and also in general much harder to provide info to players.

What we have right now
[hr][/hr]
Currently there is a main menu where you can go to the settings or play the game. 

In the settings currently only the audio tab is functional with master volume slider giving the ability to control all the sounds in the game.

In the game itself we got waves of enemies that will attack you. Currently there are 2 types of enemies, one melee and one ranged.

Player has stats like health, movement speed and damage and then the multiplier for those. Those stats are gained from items. Each mob currently its coded to drop 1 item, so 100% drop rate as we are still testing the item drops system.

Coins do nothing anymore(they were used previously to buy items from shop).

Items provide 2 potential abilities. I am saying potential because there is a chance that items do not grant any ability at all. Those abilities are: 
 Dash that damages enemies
 Ability to shoot with a projectile at enemies

Whenever a new game is started the player has the ability to shoot with a projectile by default on his 1-st slot.

Items can be equipped in the inventory to provide more stats and abilities. For now there is only 1 item that acts as every other item(helmet, boots etc.).

Mobs drop experience but for now it has no purpose.

Controls of the game
[hr][/hr]
Since the UI framework on the engine side is under rework for the 4-th time, the tooltip is outdated.

Controls are:

 W/A/S/D to move the character around.
 I to open the inventory.
1-7 Are abilities slots. IMPORTANT! Currently items do no provide information regarding if it contains an ability or not, hence some slots might not have an ability, so just smack the buttons in order to see which one does have an ability and which does not have.
ESC To open the pause menu.


Some issues to be noted
[hr][/hr]

As stated above items do not provide info regarding abilities, so its unknown if an item provides or not an ability, only way to find out is by equipping the item and see if the corresponding
 slot does something or not.
There is no dismantling option for items as of now, but do not be scared, after each wave the items do go away.
Both enemy projectiles and player projectiles are blue(laziness to make a different projectile for enemies), will be changed with the next update.


The vision of the game
[hr][/hr]
Currently the game will be similar to an ARPG
We do have a design document laying around which can be accessed and provided feedback over(please do so, it would rly help shape the future): Kamski design doc.

Upcoming future
[hr][/hr]
So now that launching the playtest on Steam is done, i am going to focus on creating the community hub and other ways for players to leave feedback and suggestions, while Philip will work to get that UI rework done. We realy appreciate any sort of feedback or suggestions, helps with the direction of the game so please do not hesitate. You can contact me on discord if its easier over there: HaidaMa is my discord username.
